Scene 02

COUNTY ROAD 10

Fox Mulder

Private john McAlpin. One of the few, the proud, but dead. Last week he wrapped his car around a tree. He died on impact.

Dana Scully

Drug and alcohol tests came back negative. The car shows no evidence of brake, steering or any other mechanical failure.

Fox Mulder

The military's calling it a suicide. They're especially concerned because... It's the second one in as many weeks.

Dana Scully

Both at the same base?

Fox Mulder

Yeah, except it's not exactly a base. Flip to the back. The marines were all stationed at the Folkstone processing center in North Carolina. More than 12,000 refugees waiting for asylum from uncle sam.

Dana Scully

Wasn't there a riot there about a month ago?

Fox Mulder

A ten-year-old boy was killed. But the, uh, details of his death were never released.

Dana Scully

Why did the military contact us?

Fox Mulder

They didn't. Mrs. McAlpin contacted the bureau when the military refused her request... To investigate her husband's death further.

Dana Scully

She doesn't believe it was suicide?

Fox Mulder

There. This is the tree that stopped private McAlpin's car. The state police reported there was graffiti on the bark.

Dana Scully

It looks like some kind of ritual symbol.

Fox Mulder

Most of the refugees at Folkstone are Haitian.

Dana Scully

Mrs. McAlpin believes voodoo was behind her husband's death?

Fox Mulder

Mrs. McAlpin doesn't believe her husband killed himself. She wants to know who did.

[ babbling ]

Scene 03

Mrs. McAlpin

Jack used to tell these jokes. Well, they were pretty dumb, I guess. But the way he told them always made me laugh. Then he got transferred to the camp, and nothing was very funny anymore.

Dana Scully

Did he ever discuss with you what went on there? What his duties included?

Mrs. McAlpin

No. He'd just come home angry. Mostly at himself, though sometimes he'd turn it on luke and me.

Dana Scully

Was he ever treated for depression or stress?

Mrs. McAlpin

No. I tried getting him to talk to someone. Even our minister. But jack believed in dealing with his own problems.

Fox Mulder

Did he believe in voodoo?

Mrs. McAlpin

The marines, his family and football... Pretty much sums up everything jack believed in.

Fox Mulder

So when did you first think that his death involved something out of the ordinary?

Mrs. McAlpin

One of the boys in his squad... Told me what they found at the accident. And he said it was some kind of voodoo curse. The same one they found on the stool... That puerto rican boy used to hang himself.

Fox Mulder

Who told you that?

Mrs. McAlpin

Harry Dunham. [ sighs ] he's from new orleans, so he's pretty superstitious about that type of thing.

Fox Mulder

And what about you?

Mrs. McAlpin

My husband had just died, so I didn't give it much thought either way. Not... Until they dug this up out of his sandbox.

[ opens drawer ]

Mrs. McAlpin

I know it sounds crazy, me worrying about all this. The truth is I'm scared. I'm scared for my child. And I just don't know what to do anymore.

Scene 08

PSYCHIATRIC INFIRMARY

Dana Scully

He's nonverbal, nonresponsive to voice, touch or pain. The neurologist suspects he suffered a severe concussion in the crash resulting in amnesia.

Fox Mulder

Plausible diagnosis, only I'm more interested in how he came back to life.

Dana Scully

Obviously he never left. Dr. Foyle made a gross mistake when he signed the death certificate. It's not the first time something like that's happened.

Fox Mulder

Get a copy of the blood test?

[ opening drawer ]

Dana Scully

Yeah. Electrolytes, white and red counts are all normal. Except this is strange. The lab detected trace levels of tetrodotoxin in his blood. That's a poison found in the liver... And reproductive organs of puffer fish, a japanese delicacy.

Fox Mulder

Only I get the feeling that private McAlpin didn't frequent too many sushi bars.

Dana Scully

You have a theory how it got into his blood?

Fox Mulder

What do you know about zombies?

Dana Scully

I hope you don't intend to tell robin McAlpin that she married one.

Fox Mulder

In 1982, a harvard ethnobotanist... Named wade davis did extensive field research... In Haiti on the zombification phenomenon. He analyzed several samples of zombie powder prepared by voodoo priests... And he found tetrodotoxin to be common to all of them.

Dana Scully

But it's a lethal poison.

Fox Mulder

But in small enough doses, it can cause paralysis... And depress cardiorespiratory activities to such a low level... That the victim might appear clinically dead.

Dana Scully

Well, zombie or not, jack McAlpin is alive.

Fox Mulder

Exactly. Which makes me wonder about the other marine who allegedly killed himself.
